sources.title: Washington L&I Verify a Contractor, Tradesperson or Business
sources.supports: Official portal to confirm a roofing contractor's Washington registration, bond, and insurance before hiring.

sources.title: Seattle Department of Construction and Inspections (SDCI)
sources.supports: City department that regulates building permits for Ballard properties in the City of Seattle.

sources.title: SDCI — Re-Roof Permit
sources.supports: States that re-roof work on one- and two-family homes and townhouses needs no permit if the envelope is unchanged (other than equal-or-better insulation); envelope changes need a construction permit; commercial/multifamily re-roof permit rules.

sources.title: SDCI — Roof Replacement Affidavit
sources.supports: Lists re-roof permit exemptions and energy code requirements for roof replacements.

sources.title: Seattle Department of Neighborhoods — Ballard Avenue Landmark District
sources.supports: Ballard shingle-industry history (world's largest by 1895) and Certificate of Approval requirement for exterior changes within the district.
